Title: General Availability: Backup and restore for Azure Web Sites

Body.Content: Backup and restore is out of preview and generally available. This release includes support for larger sites, improved reliability in handling errors and conflicts, a new backup status area in the site's blade on the Azure preview portal, backup retention in the site blade, and the option to restore a backup directly into a specific site slot.
